description: Unit test class for MetadataFromSignal, testing its behavior in extracting and managing metadata from signals and features in a Ditto-based IoT framework.

classes.name: MetadataFromSignalTest
classes.description: JUnit test class testing MetadataFromSignal behavior, setup, and edge cases.

methods.name: setUpClass
methods.description: Initializes static test fixtures before all tests run.

methods.name: setUp
methods.description: Mocks and prepares objects before each test.

methods.name: assertImmutability
methods.description: Verifies that MetadataFromSignal and related classes are immutable.

methods.name: tryToGetInstanceWithNullCommand
methods.description: Tests that passing null to MetadataFromSignal.of() throws a NullPointerException.

methods.name: getMetadataWhenEventHasNoEntityAndEntityHasNullExistingMetadata
methods.description: Checks behavior when no entity or metadata is present.

methods.name: entityHasNoMetadataAndEventDittoHeadersHaveNoMetadata
methods.description: Verifies no metadata is returned when both entity and headers lack metadata.

methods.name: entityMetadataButEventDittoHeadersHaveNoMetadata
methods.description: Ensures existing entity metadata is returned when headers lack metadata.

methods.name: createMetadataFromScratch
methods.description: Tests creation of new metadata from headers and feature modifications.

methods.name: modifyExistingMetadata
methods.description: Verifies updating existing metadata with new headers and features.

methods.name: keyWithSpecificPathOverwritesKeyWithWildcardPath
methods.description: Checks that specific metadata keys override wildcard keys during metadata extraction.
